Kyle, saw Ambient.ai doubled new ARR in FY26 and signed the global reseller deal with Securitas.

Growth and a new channel that fast usually mean more in-market accounts in the West than the team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline leaks before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ambient.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Kyle, quick follow-up for Ambient.ai.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Kyle, last bit of proof for Ambient.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ambient.ai's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Ambient.ai either way.
